body:
Prepared the requested viewport bar screenshots on head `0775d3e7dcd986e04e98c5e305acb52c7ca37862`, but this host could not update the PR body.

What changed:
1. Rendered the before (`Move` off) and after (`Move` on, `Rotate` on) viewport screenshots at `2x` scale and pushed them to the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `505af4bae5d220b35074775984373140eac6d6b7`. No image or capture code is on the PR branch.
2. `gh pr edit 2662` (`gh` 2.46.0) failed with `GraphQL: Projects (classic) is being deprecated ... (repository.pullRequest.projectCards)`, and `gh api ... --method PATCH` is denied by local permissions. A maintainer or a newer `gh` client must add the screenshot section below to the PR body before re-review.

Pinning and mutation check:
- `egui_app::tests::body_drag::shift_drag_snaps_to_the_bar_step_and_updates_the_value` and `egui_app::tests::body_turn::shift_drag_snaps_to_the_bar_angle_step` pin the Move and Rotate bar controls.
- Bypassing `viewport_bar::controls::draw` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` made both tests fail (RED). Restoring `shell.rs` made both pass (GREEN).

Gate and clippy:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 17/17 steps passed (`camcraft-ui` lib: 1227 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored; 15 integration suites passed).
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: 0 warnings, 0 errors.

Head SHA: `0775d3e7dcd986e04e98c5e305acb52c7ca37862` (unchanged). The PR remains a draft.

Screenshot section ready for the PR body:

```markdown
## Viewport bar screenshots

These images show the viewport pane (`2x` scale) with the seeded `Block` selected. The headless GPU and egui shell render the 3D scene, handles, bottom bar, and control legend.

Before (`Move` off): the resting single-row bar sits at the bottom center.

![Viewport bar before with Move off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/505af4bae5d220b35074775984373140eac6d6b7/2662/before.png)

After (`Move` on): the bar expands upward with the `X`, `Y`, `Z` buttons, distance field, `Set` button, and `Snap 1.0 mm (Shift)` control. The control legend lifts above the expanded bar.

![Viewport bar after with Move on](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/505af4bae5d220b35074775984373140eac6d6b7/2662/after-move.png)

After (`Rotate` on): the bar expands upward with the `X`, `Y`, `Z` buttons, angle field, `Set` button, and `Snap 90° (Shift)` control. The control legend lifts above the expanded bar.

![Viewport bar after with Rotate on](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/505af4bae5d220b35074775984373140eac6d6b7/2662/after-rotate.png)

The images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `505af4bae5d220b35074775984373140eac6d6b7`. No image or capture code is on the PR branch.
```
